captionEntrance.description: How captions arrive, unless a scene says.

delay.description: Seconds after the scene has arrived, its transition done, before the first unit moves.

stagger.description: Seconds between one unit and the next.

taps.description: Marks each tap; left out, taps are not marked.

poster.description: The frame App Store Connect shows before the preview plays.

at.description: Seconds after the scene has arrived, its transition done.

scene.description: A scene recorded in the take.

stretches.description: Which stretches to use, in order, each optionally trimmed; all of them if left out.

start.description: Seconds to leave out from the start.

end.description: Seconds to leave out from the end.

speed.description: How fast the stretch plays; real time if left out.

ramp.description: Seconds to reach the rate from real time at the start, and to return at the end.

trim.description: Footage to leave out of either end of the scene as edited.

start.description: Seconds to leave out from the start.

end.description: Seconds to leave out from the end.

oneOf.description: The next scene fades in over this one.
This scene fades out to the background, then the next fades in.

motionBlur.description: Peak blur along the motion, as a fraction of the frame along it.

oneOf.description: The next scene pushes this one out.

y.description: Where the caption's centre sits, from the top.

delay.description: Seconds after the scene has arrived, its transition done, before the first unit moves.

stagger.description: Seconds between one unit and the next.

zoom.description: A zoom, or zooms in turn, each from where the one before left the frame.

to.description: Scale once the zoom completes; 1 is the full frame.

x.description: Horizontal position of the zoom’s point, from the left.

y.description: Vertical position of the zoom’s point, from the top.

aim.description: Whether the point stays where it is, or moves as near the centre as the frame allows.

at.description: Seconds after the scene has arrived, its transition done, when the zoom starts.

to.description: Scale once the zoom completes; 1 is the full frame.

x.description: Horizontal position of the zoom’s point, from the left.

y.description: Vertical position of the zoom’s point, from the top.

aim.description: Whether the point stays where it is, or moves as near the centre as the frame allows.

at.description: Seconds after the scene has arrived, its transition done, when the zoom starts.

taps.description: Whether to mark taps, when the preview marks them.

still.description: A still the test captures with PromoStill.capture.

file.description: An image to use in place of a captured still, relative to promokit.json, such as a photographed window. Used on every device.

theme.description: Set as data-theme, for brand.css to style.

highlights.description: Whether to draw the regions the test highlighted when it captured the still.

slot.description: The product page header, the search-result asset, or the 16:9 universal image that serves both.

template.description: An HTML fragment, relative to promokit.json, whose data-copy and data-still elements the kit fills.

css.description: Stylesheets, relative to promokit.json, loaded after brand.css.

device.description: One of the stills devices in promokit.json.

theme.description: Set as data-theme on the canvas.

search.description: For a universal asset, whether it also fills the search-result placement.

footage.description: Makes the creative a video: the take and scenes its data-footage box plays.
